title: POV: Walking Old-Town Chongqing in the Rain | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone shoots Chongqing's sci-fi skyline. This is the city under it: a wet, stone-paved old-town lane of wooden shophouses, red lanterns and worn signboards, best on a grey rainy afternoon when the crowds thin out.

Chongqing is China's great mountain city — built up steep slopes above the Jialing and Yangtze rivers, its old quarters stacked in stairs and stilted houses rather than flat blocks. Walking it is a workout, and that's the point.

🧭 Expert Tip: go on a rainy weekday. The old town empties out, the stone glistens, and you'll actually hear the place instead of the crowd.

别只拍洪崖洞的天际线——雨天的山城老街，青石板、红灯笼、旧招牌，才是重庆的里子。
